in_sanskrit.name: Chinnasamy
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Young Master
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Chinnasamy एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Chinnasamy means 'Young Master' in Tamil. It is a name that signifies wisdom, strength, and leadership. The name is derived from the Tamil words 'chinna' which means 'young' and 'samy' which means 'master'. It is a name that is often given to a young boy who is expected to grow up to become a wise and strong leader.
